vocabulary.meaning_en: a show with acrobats, jugglers and other performers
vocabulary.example: The circus is in town this week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a kind of art, like painting, dance or poetry
vocabulary.example: Is cooking an art form?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a special event with shows and activities
vocabulary.example: We went to a food festival.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a shelter made of cloth
vocabulary.example: The show was inside a huge tent.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who entertains people in a show
vocabulary.example: The performers bowed at the end.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a happy event to honor something
vocabulary.example: The festival was a celebration of art.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who is good at sports
vocabulary.example: Athletes train every day.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an ability you get by practice
vocabulary.example: Juggling is a special skill.

vocabulary.meaning_en: special clothes for a show
vocabulary.example: The actors wore colorful costumes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to move back and forth while hanging
vocabulary.example: Monkeys swing from tree to tree.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a bar hanging high on ropes, used by circus artists
vocabulary.example: The trapeze artist flew through the air.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who throws and catches many things at once
vocabulary.example: The juggler kept five balls in the air.

vocabulary.meaning_en: from one side to the other again and again
vocabulary.example: They threw the ball back and forth.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a subject people discuss or disagree about
vocabulary.example: We talked about this issue for an hour.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say that something is true, often unwillingly
vocabulary.example: I admit that you are right.

vocabulary.meaning_en: with the top part at the bottom
vocabulary.example: She hung upside down on the ring.

vocabulary.meaning_en: trying to win against others
vocabulary.example: Football is a very competitive sport.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in a smooth and beautiful way
vocabulary.example: The dancer moved gracefully.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very surprising and wonderful
vocabulary.example: These young performers are amazing.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have the same opinion
vocabulary.example: I agree with you.

fine_lines.title: agree vs disagree
fine_lines.explanation_ar: agree = لنا نفس الرأي، disagree = رأيي مختلف. نقول agree with someone وagree on something. لا نقول I am agree، بل I agree.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Agree = same opinion; disagree = different opinion. Say agree with someone, agree on something. Say I agree, not I am agree.

examples.sentence: I agree with you on that point.

fine_lines.title: athlete vs artist
fine_lines.explanation_ar: athlete شخص بارع في الرياضة والقوة البدنية. artist شخص يصنع الفن (رسم، رقص، شعر). بيت يرى المؤدين athletes وآنا تراهم artists.
fine_lines.explanation_en: An athlete is good at sports. An artist makes art. Pete thinks the performers are athletes; Anna thinks they are artists.

examples.sentence: The runner is a strong athlete.

expressions.meaning_en: You said something true and smart.
expressions.example: That's a good point. I didn't think of that.
You think it's boring? I completely disagree.

expressions.phrase: I hear what you're saying, but...
expressions.meaning_en: I understand you, but I still disagree.
expressions.example: I hear what you're saying, but I still want to go.
I see your point, but it's too expensive.

expressions.phrase: I agree with you on that point.
expressions.meaning_en: I agree with this part of what you said.
expressions.example: Yes, it's late. I agree with you on that point.

expressions.meaning_en: We both think this is true.
expressions.example: The food was good. We can agree on that.
You're right. The shop is closed today.

expressions.phrase: That's an interesting point of view.
expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to start disagreeing.
expressions.example: That's an interesting point of view, but I don't agree.

grammar.title: Agreeing and disagreeing politely
grammar.explanation_ar: للموافقة: I agree. / You're right. / That's a good point. / We can agree on that. للاختلاف بأدب: نبدأ بجملة لطيفة ثم نقول رأينا: I see your point, but... / I hear what you're saying, but... / That's an interesting point of view, but I disagree. استخدم agree بدون am: I agree (وليس I am agree).
grammar.explanation_en: To agree: I agree. / You're right. / That's a good point. To disagree politely, start with something kind, then give your idea: I see your point, but... / I hear what you're saying, but... Say I agree, never I am agree.
examples: That's a good point. They are athletic.
I see your point, but they are artists too.
I agree with you on that point.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation_en: We say I agree, without am.

questions.question: Which is a polite way to disagree?
choices: I see your point, but I think differently.
questions.explanation_ar: I see your point, but... طريقة مهذبة للاختلاف.
questions.explanation_en: I see your point, but... is a polite way to disagree.

questions.question: A person who throws and catches many balls is a ____.
questions.explanation_ar: juggler هو من يرمي الكرات ويلتقطها.
questions.explanation_en: A juggler throws and catches things.

questions.question: 'Upside down' means:
choices: with the top at the bottom
questions.explanation_en: Upside down means the top part is at the bottom.

questions.question: Kate says circus is not ____ because performers don't try to win.
questions.explanation_en: Competitive means trying to win against others.

questions.question: Special clothes for a show are called a ____.
questions.explanation_en: A costume is special clothing for a show.

questions.question: 'We're going back and forth on this issue' means:
questions.explanation_ar: تعني أن النقاش يتردد بين الرأيين دون اتفاق.
questions.explanation_en: It means they keep arguing and don't agree.

questions.question: Pete says, 'I will ____ -- I like their costumes.' (say it's true)
questions.explanation_en: Admit means to say something is true.

questions.question: A person who is good at sports is an ____.
questions.explanation_en: An athlete is good at sports.

questions.question: Which phrase shows agreement?
questions.explanation_ar: That's a good point تعبّر عن الموافقة.
questions.explanation_en: That's a good point shows you agree.
